rainbowMarker:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: transparent game menu active-state Kalistel emblem.
Reference image 1 is the existing Kalistel emblem. Recreate the SAME tall faceted diamond silhouette, its symmetric engraved copper/silver frame, geometry and strong silver bevels. Change ONLY the crystal's internal coloration to a refined prismatic RAINBOW: cyan, emerald, blue, violet, rose and warm gold facets, coherent light refraction across crisp gemstone cuts. Every hue represented subtly, sophisticated luminous fantasy gemstone, not a flat rainbow gradient. Slight magical cyberpunk energy inside, not outside.
Make it a single centered upright object on genuinely transparent RGBA background. Preserve narrow silhouette and frame, generous transparent padding. No text, no background, no circle, no badge, no shadow haze, no bloom outside the gem, no extra ornaments. Crisp and readable at 16 pixels, polished Kalistar painterly metallic identity.
approvedProposal:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished visual proposal board for the navigation identity and signature display typography of the existing French fantasy card game KALISTAR. This is a concept for user review, NOT a deployed interface, NOT a new logo and NOT a downloadable font specimen. Landscape composition approximately 1536x1024, straight-on crisp professional game UI design, exceptionally readable.
Reference image 1 is the existing KALISTAR CARD GAME logo: preserve its name, proportions, silver letter faces, worn copper edges, central faceted crystal and restrained angular motifs. Do not redesign the logo.
Reference image 2 is the actual existing game Arsenal screen: use it for continuity of materials, dark green-black grimoire surfaces, copper detailing and precise small-scale fantasy craftsmanship. Replace the generic navigation styling in the concept only. Do NOT reproduce the original page content, account name, profile information, weapon descriptions or version numbers.

Composition: a single flat, beautifully organized design presentation, no nested cards. Top: the existing Kalistar logo prominent but not oversized, followed by a full-width DESKTOP NAVIGATION STRIP. Six real navigation items, readable exact text: "Collection", "Story", "Decks", "Armes", "Arène", "Statistiques". Icons to the left of the labels. "Decks" is selected: its icon has a restrained jade crystal glint and a copper underline with a single tiny faceted crystal marker; selected label is bright silver. Other labels remain clearly readable, not dim/low contrast. Keep header compact like a usable game interface; no oversized hero, no giant plaques enclosing every label.
Middle: a family of six larger ICON DESIGN STUDIES in a neat horizontal row, each fully visible, same optical size, with corresponding exact captions "Collection", "Story", "Decks", "Armes", "Arène", "Statistiques". These are not generic white line icons. They are a cohesive collection of simple engraved silver pictograms with thin copper bevels and subtly faceted notches, inspired by the game's logo. Strong small-size silhouettes, modest relief, economical detail, no thick circular badges, no piles of ornaments, no glowing background orbs.
Specific motifs: Collection = bound card album with two visible card corners; Story = an open book with a small quill, unmistakably different from Collection; Decks = a fan of three cards and one tiny captain crown notch; Armes = one clearly readable sword with a faceted hilt; Arène = two crossed blades with a restrained center crystal; Statistiques = three rising engraved bars on a slim baseline, not a trophy.
Lower left: a typographic study with exact text "KALISTAR", then "COMPOSITION", then "Arène", and a small readable sample "ATK 184 · DEF 206". The proposed signature display letterforms must echo the existing logo's elegant Roman-inscription capitals, wedge serifs, decisive K diagonals, pointed A apex and restrained crystal-like cuts. NOT Gothic, NOT illegible medieval calligraphy, NOT skinny strokes. No elaborate swashes; French accent in Arène must be clear. Proportions and spacing natural; letter spacing 0. Menu labels use a restrained version of the signature style. The small stat sample uses clean ordinary humanist UI lettering with tabular numbers, clearly demonstrating a separate functional text style.
Lower right: two crisp MOBILE COMPONENT PREVIEWS, a compact top bar with the existing logo and simple profile and settings controls, followed by a comfortably sized bottom navigation strip. Bottom strip has exactly five spacious tabs with icons above exact labels "Collection", "Decks", "Armes", "Arène", "Plus". "Decks" selected using the same underline and small crystal marker. The Plus icon is three restrained faceted dots. Target a 412px-wide phone, icons visually around 26px, labels readable, finger-friendly targets at least 48px. Show these navigation components at a size that can actually be inspected on the board; no tiny complete phone mockup full of invented content. "Story" and "Statistiques" belong in Plus.
Only short section captions if needed: "MENU PC", "ICÔNES", "TYPOGRAPHIE", "MENU MOBILE". No other explanatory copy. No lorem ipsum, no watermark, no fake menus.
Palette and materials: near-black ink, worn silver-white, oxidized copper, restrained emerald/jade selected state with very small icy cyan/ruby hints recalling the crystal. Controlled contrast, subtle paper/leather grimoire texture on the backing, no sepia domination, no enormous gradients, no orange/brown wash, no excessive gold and no loud neon. Professional premium fantasy UI with visual restraint. All UI edges, icons and text fully inside the canvas and never overlapping.
productionAtlas:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production navigation sprite atlas for the Kalistar game, transparent RGBA.
Reference image 1 is the approved art-direction board. Derive the same engraved silver/copper icon language, preserve its heroic fantasy grimoire identity, now add a LIGHT futuristic cyberpunk accent: tiny cyan energy inlays in carved runes, refined engineered joints. Predominantly silver and warm copper, very restrained cyan. No neon haze, no modern generic HUD.
Create a single landscape atlas with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal square cells. Eight isolated pictorial symbols. Their optical centers must coincide with cell centers. Each symbol entirely contained within the middle 72% of its cell. Consistent apparent size, thick enough silhouettes to remain recognizable at 32px.
Top row left to right: (1) COLLECTION: closed dark jade leather album, two fanned cards behind, copper/silver edges, central faceted Kalistel diamond with one cyan inlay. (2) STORY: open antique book with silver quill, copper binding, small cyan rune. (3) DECKS: three fanned dark jade cards with copper/silver edges and a small crown emblem. (4) WEAPONS: single elegant diagonal sword, silver blade, copper geometric hilt, fine cyan engraved line.
Bottom row left to right: (5) ARENA: crossed silver swords with copper hilts, centered faceted tiny cyan crystal. (6) STATISTICS: three rising beveled silver/copper bars on thin copper baseline, tiny cyan inlays. (7) MORE: THREE small horizontal faceted silver/copper diamonds, cyan centers, aligned across the center of the cell. (8) ACTIVE MARKER: single upright elongated faceted Kalistel diamond, copper/silver outline, cyan upper facets and deep ruby lower facets.
Strong polished painterly game-object rendering, crisp bevels, front view except book/card perspective, no enclosing circles, no badges, no platforms. True fully transparent background between and outside objects, including holes. No text or labels anywhere. No grid lines, no background, no logo, no UI panels, no drop shadow. This atlas will be sliced at exact quarter-width/half-height boundaries into reusable game assets.
